title: Ottawa Knee Rule
sources: Stiell IG et al. Ann Emerg Med 1995; JAMA 1997 (validation) — sensitivity ~ 98–100% for clinically significant fractures
purpose: Rules out the need for a knee X-ray after acute blunt injury. Less well validated < 18 y; unreliable with intoxication, an uncooperative exam, or a distracting injury.

items.label: Isolated tenderness of the patella (no other bony tenderness)
Tenderness at the head of the fibula
Unable to flex the knee to 90°
Unable to bear weight (4 steps) both immediately AND in the ED

notes: Bear-weight = transfer weight twice onto each leg (4 steps), able to limp. 'Isolated' patellar tenderness means no tenderness anywhere else on the knee.
